title: tests: only use cached images for the integration tests
body:

#### What type of PR is this?

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Avoid hitting some external registries

tests: add missing registry.access.redhat.com to cache config

registry.access.redhat.com/ubi10 is used by the tests and in our cache
but the config never redirected there so it still tried to pull from the
internet.

tests: replace registry.k8s.io/pause with quay.io/libpod/k8s-pause

registry.k8s.io is not cached and the content there can change without
our control. Switch to our own copy quay.io/libpod/k8s-pause.
The latest or 3.1 tag there is not cached so use the 3.5 tag.

#### How to verify it

I found these via https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/pull/7119 which is a larger topic but the fix here should bring us one step closer and make tests more resilient.

comments.body: I mark this as draft for now, will return this when I am back. We need to cache the 3.5-no-win tag to avoid all the large windows images attached to the newer pause image. Otherwise the tests get really slow when they download all platforms.
